$comment: Dependency license policy for haxcms-php (Apache-2.0), used by .github/workflows/dependency-license.yml via .github/scripts/license-check.cjs (haxtheweb/issues#3262). allow: licenses that pass. review: license families that are not automatically compatible and need a maintainer decision (the check fails with a 'needs review' message). deny: incompatible license families. Anything else, or no license at all, fails. exceptions: packages a maintainer has looked at and accepted, matched on ecosystem + name + license, so a license change re-triggers review.
